decision: Answer a specific question not covered by a scheduled report, or rerun a report for another period.
sections: Request (question, decision it supports, period, audience)
Method and sources
Result
Limits and caveats
Promote-to-registry decision

kpis.name: K-OD-SLA Requests on time
kpis.definition: Requests delivered within the SLA of their type / requests

kpis.name: K-OD-REPEAT Repeat requests
kpis.definition: Requests for the same question 2+ times in 90 days

data_sources: Any registry KPI or report generator
cadence: on demand
channel: /admin/reports Request form or a Jira/Linear comment; result in S3 + report_run; technical analyses in docs/audits/<date>-S<nnn>-<slug>/
retention: Per the most sensitive data in the result

name_vi: Báo cáo phân phối phần mềm và DORA hằng tháng
decision: Is delivery fast and safe enough; where to invest in CI, tests or review?
sections: DORA per app: deployment frequency, lead time for changes, change failure rate, time to restore
CI health: duration, failure rate on main, re-runs, flaky tests, Actions minutes
Release versions shipped (DEV-02)
Post-deploy verify failures and rollbacks
Improvement actions

kpis.name: K-DORA-DF Deployment frequency
kpis.definition: Successful deploy runs per app per week (deploy-dev.yml for CIS, Booking, Partner; deploy-web-dev.yml / deploy-portal-dev.yml for Partner; deploy-lambdas.yml for TripPlanner; vercel-deploy.yml)
kpis.target_or_threshold: >= daily on active apps (elite band, context only)

kpis.name: K-DORA-LT Lead time for changes
kpis.definition: Median time from PR first commit to the successful deploy that contains the merge SHA

kpis.name: K-DORA-CFR Change failure rate
kpis.definition: Deploys followed within 24 h by a rollback, a fix PR on the same area, a failed post-deploy-verify or an incident / deploys

kpis.name: K-DORA-MTTR Time to restore
kpis.definition: Median OPS-04 time to restore

kpis.name: K-CI-MAINFAIL CI failure rate on main
kpis.definition: Failed ci.yml runs on main / runs

data_sources: gh run list / GitHub API for deploy workflows, post-deploy-verify.yml, ci.yml, release-please.yml in each app repo
cadence: monthly business day 2
channel: S3 + /admin/reports; Markdown in docs/audits/<date>-S<nnn>-delivery/; headline in EX-02
build_effort: M (3 engineer-days): root scheduled workflow collecting GitHub data to JSON + generator
cost: 0 USD while repos are public; ~30 private-repo Actions minutes per month after the root repo goes private in November 2026 (inside the free allowance)
notes: Bands from the DORA research are context, not targets for a one-person dev team; trend matters.

name_vi: Biên bản nghiệm thu UAT theo app
audience: business owner (accepts), tech lead, staff testers
decision: Does each app do what the business needs, recorded on video, and is it accepted for go-live?
sections: 1. Scope: apps and roles tested (CIS admin + portal, TripPlanner, Booking, CRM)
2. Scenario list per app with expected result
3. Result per scenario: pass / fail / pass with note, video link, screenshot
4. Defects found with severity and fix status
5. Sign-off: accepted / accepted with conditions / rejected, by role and date

kpis.name: K-UAT-PASS Scenario pass rate
kpis.definition: Scenarios passed / scenarios run, per app

kpis.name: K-UAT-DEFECTS Open blocking defects
kpis.definition: Severity 1-2 defects found in UAT not yet fixed and verified

kpis.name: K-UAT-COVER Video coverage
kpis.definition: Scenarios with a recorded video / scenarios

data_sources: Recorded videos (Google Drive folder per memory gdrive-adventureasia-folder)
cadence: event: once after all technical work or when the business owner says (AA-855, > S262); repeat for major releases before prod
channel: docs/audits/<date>-S<nnn>-uat/README.md via root PR (links, no personal data) + a clickable sign-off page for the business owner; summary in the Jira epic per app
build_effort: S (1 engineer-day) for the template and scenario list; recording time separate
notes: Agent records the videos itself with E2E logins (memory screenshots-self-serve). Becomes P1 when a go-live date is set.
